event_feifei_lost_scroll_r0.why: 驗收退回（嚴重）：菲菲舉在臉前的右爪手背朝觀眾、只豎起一根指頭（其實兩指併攏），在遊戲實際尺寸下很像在比中指；卷軸每段多畫了張開的 V 字手勢，她比的也對不上。構圖保留（跪在卷軸靠觀眾這側、卷軸平攤、從背後看），右爪不再舉起，兩隻爪子都按在卷軸上比對；卷軸三段圖解照主圖（只有三隻出招小貓，不畫手勢圖）。
event_feifei_lost_scroll_r0.scene: Copy the composition of reference image 3 (the previous version of this same picture) closely. SETTING: the few worn grey stone steps and the small patch of grey stone paving of reference image 3 (no book stall and no stall keeper in this picture). The SAME long old cream paper scroll as in reference image 4 (rolled wooden ends, divided into three sections by thin lines) lies unrolled FLAT on the stone paving at the foot of the steps, stretched from left to right. Each of the three sections holds ONLY one brown ink drawing of a little cat in a ninja pose with a few motion lines, exactly like reference image 4 (a punching pose, a flying kick, a wide low stance). There are NO separate drawings of paws or hands and NO V signs anywhere on the scroll; ink pictures only, no writing. Feifei kneels on the NEAR side of the scroll, in the FOREGROUND in front of its LEFT part, seen in a three-quarter BACK view: we see her back, her ponytail with the purple bow, her tail, and her face in profile as she leans forward over the scroll. The scroll is turned the right way up for her (the tops of the drawings point away from her, into the picture), so the viewer sees the drawings the right way up too; all three sections stay visible, none hidden under her body. She compares the drawings one section at a time with BOTH paws kept LOW, down on the paper: her RIGHT paw lies flat on the scroll right beside the first drawing, pressing the paper open while she studies it, and her LEFT paw rests flat on the near edge of the scroll. Both paws are soft round closed paws with all fingers together; NO single finger or claw sticks up or points, and no paw is lifted up near her face or chest. Eyes on the drawing, a careful, concentrating face. Her black scarf and the row of gold needle tubes at her black belt are visible.
refs: the PREVIOUS version of this same picture: copy its composition closely - the grey stone steps and paving, the scroll lying flat from left to right, Feifei kneeling in the foreground at the left in a three-quarter back view, leaning over it. Its mistakes, which must NOT be repeated: her right paw is raised in front of her face with one digit sticking up (at small size it reads as a rude gesture), and the scroll has extra V-sign hand drawings. In the new picture BOTH of her paws stay down flat on the scroll, no digit raised, and the scroll shows only the three little cat figures of reference image 4.

the main picture of this same event: copy its scroll EXACTLY - cream paper, rolled wooden ends, three sections, each with one brown ink little cat in a ninja pose plus motion lines, and no hand drawings. Take only the scroll, not the book stall, the stall keeper or Feifei's pose.

event_medicine_cat_r3.why: 同事件主圖、r0、r1 的櫃台左半都有裝手裏劍苦無的開口忍具木箱與價目牌，這張櫃台只剩四瓶藥，道具少一半。構圖（三花貓餵解藥拿筆記本、球球臉色發青冒綠氣坐地上、淡奶油色）全部照現在這張，只把櫃台照新主圖補上忍具木箱與價目牌。
event_medicine_cat_r3.scene: Copy the composition of reference image 3 (the current version of this same picture) closely: same characters, same poses, same places. SETTING: the SAME small wooden market stall as in reference image 4 (the main picture of this event): a slanted brown plank roof with a dark-red cloth awning under its front edge, two wooden posts, a long wooden counter, and the same small patch of grey stone floor; the space behind the counter between the posts is OPEN and EMPTY (transparent) - no grey panel, no wall. The counter now holds the full set of goods of reference image 4: on the LEFT half the small open wooden box with its lid tipped back, heaped with mixed ninja tools (steel shuriken, kunai, round black smoke balls, a coil of rope), with two shuriken and one kunai lying on the counter in front of it; next to it the small upright wooden price board painted only with three little dried-fish pictures (no letters, no numbers); on the RIGHT half the four corked glass medicine bottles in a row (a round red one, a round blue one, a square yellow one and a tall green one). Behind the counter the CALICO CAT stall keeper (white fur with big orange and black patches, pink ears, olive-green kimono) leans over the counter toward Qiuqiu: with one paw she holds a small wooden spoon of antidote up to Qiuqiu's mouth, and in her other paw she holds a small notebook and a brush, taking notes (the viewer sees only the notebook's cover with a small paw-print mark; its pages face her). Qiuqiu sits on the stone floor in front of the stall on the right, numb and dizzy from his own poison: a sickly pale-green tint on his face, a wobbly tangled mouth, sweat drops, small green wavy fumes above his head, his paws limp in his lap. His body fur is the pale cream colour with grey-brown stripes of reference image 1 - NOT grey; only his face has the light sick green tint.
refs: the CURRENT version of this same picture: copy it closely - the calico cat leaning over the counter feeding Qiuqiu antidote from a wooden spoon while holding a notebook and a brush, and Qiuqiu sitting on the stone floor on the right, numb and sick with a green-tinted face and green fumes, in his pale cream colours. Its only mistake: the counter holds only the four bottles - the open box of ninja tools and the price board of reference image 4 are missing and must be added.

the main picture of this same event: copy its counter goods exactly - the open wooden box heaped with shuriken, kunai, smoke balls and rope on the left, the upright price board with three dried-fish pictures, the four medicine bottles on the right - plus the stall, the stone floor patch and the calico cat's look. Not the poses.

event_coop_seesaw_r2.why: 連線共用圖（四隻都看到、不畫主角）。主圖與新 r0 是同一座機關：斜梁從右下地面翹到左上柱頂的木架旁、中間齒輪轉軸、右邊欄杆、地上貓掌印；r2 卻畫成一座水平、兩頭有座位的翹翹板加坐墊，明顯不是同一座。照主圖與新 r0 的機關、角度、樣式重畫；這個選項沒人去拿架上東西，布包木盒留在架上；兩人玩完坐地上歇著，用地上兩個坐墊和毛巾表示。
event_coop_seesaw_r2.scene: SETTING exactly as in reference images 2 and 3, the SAME machine seen from the same angle: a round wooden plank platform floor; a giant wooden seesaw plank with black iron corner brackets, resting on a big central gear axle on a wooden stand; the plank's HIGH end rises to the UPPER LEFT and rests right beside a small wooden shelf fixed on top of a tall wooden post at the left; the plank's LOW end rests on the floor at the lower RIGHT, where a cat paw print is carved into the floor; a short wooden railing with round-knobbed posts runs behind the gear. Keep the plank tilted exactly this way (high on the left at the shelf, low on the right) - it is NOT a level playground seesaw: no seats, no handles, no seat boxes on its ends. The dark-blue tied cloth bundle and the small wooden box still sit up on the shelf on top of the post, untouched, as in reference image 2. This is AFTER two friends have played on the seesaw for a while and then sat down on the floor to rest: two small square floor cushions (one dark red, one navy blue, each with a little embroidered paw print and small tassels at the corners) lie side by side on the wooden platform floor in its front LEFT part, slightly squashed as if someone just sat on them, and a crumpled white hand towel with a blue stripe lies between them. No characters at all.
refs: the main picture of this same event: copy this EXACT machine - the tall post with the small shelf at the upper left holding the dark-blue cloth bundle and the small wooden box, the plank rising from the lower right to the upper left, the central gear axle, the black iron brackets, the round wooden floor, the carved paw print and the railing. The bundle and the box stay up on the shelf.
